stories.title: Select the identity architecture and contracts
stories.description: Select and document the current Azure identity and session architecture, then add the smallest shared typed contract for later website and API stories.
acceptanceCriteria: The decision supports local email/password accounts, Google, Facebook, anonymous browsing, secure managed sessions, and stable provider-independent Game Hub user IDs
The design preserves the existing Azure Front Door, Azure Static Web Apps, and linked Azure Container Apps boundaries and cites current official Microsoft service documentation

Secret values remain outside source, memory, logs, outputs, and browser bundles; unavoidable provider credentials use secure service storage or Azure Key Vault references and deployment automation uses keyless identity
A shared typed contract defines the supported credential methods, platform identity seam, internal user ID boundary, anonymous/authenticated session states, and non-secret same-origin endpoints
No authentication UI, provider registration, live Azure deployment, or completion claim for later issue requirements is introduced
stories.notes: Selected Microsoft Entra External ID in an external tenant behind one Azure Static Web Apps custom Microsoft Entra provider. Documented local email/password, Google, Facebook, anonymous access, managed session, provider-independent Game Hub user ID, trusted linked-API principal, Key Vault certificate, keyless deployment, provider-secret, and deferred-policy boundaries. Added a framework-neutral typed contract in src/auth/contract.ts with deterministic tests. Full yarn validate passed with 260 tests, coverage, immutable install, formatting, lint, policy, fail-closed simulations, security audit, generated-state, type, build, bundle, and Storybook gates. No authentication UI, provider registration, Azure resource creation, deployment, or live flow verification was performed.

stories.title: Resolve internal identities and sessions
stories.description: Add the authenticated API boundary that validates the trusted platform principal, creates or resolves one provider-independent Game Hub user record, and returns the internal session contract.
acceptanceCriteria: The API trusts identity context only through the Azure Static Web Apps linked-backend boundary
Repeated authentication for the same external identity resolves the same internal Game Hub user ID
Anonymous and authenticated session responses match the shared contract without exposing provider tokens or credentials
stories.notes: Added the linked Azure Container Apps API workspace and shared @game-hub/auth-contract package. The session endpoint validates only the Azure Static Web Apps x-ms-client-principal boundary, aad provider alias, and authenticated role, then returns only the anonymous or provider-independent Game Hub session shape. Added race-safe Azure Tables identity resolution using a SHA-256 platform-identity key, generated opaque user ID, dedicated keyless storage account, API runtime managed identity, Storage Table Data Contributor role, typed non-secret configuration, diagnostics, container build, and deterministic tests. No authentication UI, provider registration or credentials, live Azure deployment, or later flow behavior was introduced. Full yarn validate passed with 286 tests, and yarn infra:check passed.

stories.title: Render anonymous and authenticated website state
stories.description: Load the application session and add responsive website state that keeps browsing and game play available anonymously while clearly representing signed-in users.
acceptanceCriteria: Anonymous visitors can browse and play without an authentication redirect
The website exposes loading, anonymous, and authenticated session states through the shared contract
The site header and relevant navigation present an accessible sign-in or authenticated-state affordance
stories.notes: Added an application-level authentication session provider that bootstraps from the Azure Static Web Apps /.auth/me session, resolves authenticated visitors through the same-origin /api/auth/session endpoint, validates the shared anonymous/authenticated response, and fails safely to anonymous without redirecting public content. The provider remains mounted across client-side navigation and reloads from the managed session after a refresh. The responsive site header now shows an accessible loading status, same-origin Microsoft Entra External ID sign-in affordance for anonymous visitors, or signed-in status without displaying the internal Game Hub user ID. Added deterministic loader, context, anonymous-play, and header tests and included the new runtime modules in coverage. Full yarn validate passed with 298 tests and yarn infra:check passed. No provider registration, local/social account lifecycle, return-path, sign-out, failure UI, account linking, or live Azure configuration was implemented.

stories.title: Enable local account lifecycle
stories.description: Configure the selected identity service and website entry points for local registration, sign-in, email verification, forgotten-password, and password-reset flows.
acceptanceCriteria: A user can register and sign in with an email and password through Microsoft Entra External ID
Email verification and self-service password reset are enabled through the identity service
Game Hub never receives or stores plaintext passwords

stories.title: Enable Google and Facebook sign-in
stories.description: Configure Google and Facebook federation in the selected Microsoft Entra External ID user flow using secure provider credential handling.
acceptanceCriteria: Configured Google accounts can authenticate through the shared customer user flow
Configured Facebook accounts can authenticate through the shared customer user flow
Provider credentials are absent from source, committed parameters, logs, artifacts, and pull-request content

stories.title: Preserve return paths and support sign-out
stories.description: Add validated same-origin return paths and sign-out behavior that clears website authentication state from any authenticated page.
acceptanceCriteria: Successful sign-in can return users only to a validated same-origin website path
Canceled or completed authentication never redirects to an untrusted origin
A user can sign out from any authenticated page and the website immediately returns to anonymous state

stories.title: Handle authentication failures and duplicate identities
stories.description: Implement clear handling for authentication errors, canceled flows, duplicate accounts, unavailable providers, and identity-resolution conflicts without guessing the unresolved linking policy.
acceptanceCriteria: Provider cancellation, provider outage, invalid or expired flow, and session-resolution failures produce clear recoverable states
Potential duplicate identities fail safely and do not merge accounts by email alone
The implementation preserves the issue's open multi-credential linking decision for explicit resolution

stories.title: Harden accessibility and abuse protection
stories.description: Apply the issue-required accessibility, responsive behavior, secure credential handling, and automated registration and credential-attack protections.
acceptanceCriteria: Login, registration, verification, reset, error, and signed-out states are keyboard accessible, screen-reader coherent, and responsive
Azure Front Door and identity-service protections cover authentication traffic with environment-aware controls
No password, provider credential, session token, or secret value is exposed to source control or browser-readable configuration

stories.title: Complete authentication test coverage
stories.description: Add deterministic unit, integration, accessibility, and browser-flow coverage for the complete anonymous, local, social, session, return-path, sign-out, and failure behavior.
acceptanceCriteria: Tests cover anonymous browsing and authenticated session persistence
Tests cover local, Google, Facebook, sign-out, return-path, cancellation, duplicate, and unavailable-provider behavior
Tests prove secret values and untrusted redirect targets cannot enter browser or committed configuration

stories.title: Configure Azure and verify deployment
stories.description: Complete environment-specific Azure identity configuration and verify the deployed development flow against the authorized subscription without persisting secrets in repository evidence.
acceptanceCriteria: Deployment automation explicitly targets subscription 11213dbd-39fe-46ba-87db-5f5e8c449aed and uses keyless workload identity
Development configuration verifies local, Google, Facebook, anonymous, session refresh, return-path, sign-out, and protected API behavior through the canonical Azure Front Door origin
Verification records only non-secret resource identities, endpoints, and outcomes and distinguishes repository proof from live Azure evidence

stories.title: Reconcile issue completion and exact-head checks
stories.description: Reconcile every issue requirement and open decision against implementation and live evidence, then require exact-head deterministic and adversarial checks while keeping the pull request draft.
acceptanceCriteria: Every issue requirement and acceptance criterion maps to implementation and verification evidence or an explicit blocker
The exact pull-request head has one successful Continuous integration result and one successful Adversarial Review / unit-test-reviewer result
The pull request remains draft and is neither merged nor marked ready
